### 🧪 NetSpeedTray 2.2.0-rc.2

A small follow-up to rc.1. Unless something comes up, this becomes 2.2.0.

**Prereleases don't update in-app, and WinGet and the Store won't offer this one.** Download Setup.exe or the portable zip below and install over rc.1, any beta or 2.1.7. If you're on rc.1 or a beta, the running app closes itself and comes back. Your history and settings carry over.

### What's new since rc.1

- **Windows 10: the widget no longer blinks out when you maximize and restore windows.** It comes back in a few milliseconds instead of up to a few seconds. Thanks @pasharm for the diagnosis and the measurements.
- On Windows 11 the widget is back a little sooner after Task View or Win+Tab.
- Turkish fixes. Thanks @lezgintekay.

### What's next

If this one's quiet for about a week, it ships as 2.2.0 through the in-app updater, WinGet and the Store. Translations are still being checked in #364.

Found something? Comment on #373 with a support bundle (Export Support Bundle at the bottom of Settings). Usernames, paths and IPs are stripped from it.

Full changelog: https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/blob/main/changelog.md
